caption:
🧠 You can train a real LLM from scratch for less than ₹40.

minimind builds a 64M-param model in ~2 hours on a single 3090, for about 3 RMB. Not a toy: pretrain, SFT, LoRA and full RLHF, all in native PyTorch you can actually read. 54k stars, Apache 2.0.

Clone it, run two scripts, then chat with a model you built.
